title: You Did It

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Holy shit you did it! WE did it! This is going to be epic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Holy shit you did it! WE did it! This is going to be epic.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Not gonna lie I had my doubts but here you are like a smooth base line.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not gonna lie I had my doubts but here you are like a smooth base line.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Ha. I’m sure. And now you’re here to whisk me away from this life of crawling through clubs and plop me into one of mediocrity, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha. I’m sure. And now you’re here to whisk me away from this life of crawling through clubs and plop me into one of mediocrity, right?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Call 'em like I see 'em. Yet you proved me wrong so here we are. Wish I had a pack of glow sticks for yah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Call 'em like I see 'em. Yet you proved me wrong so here we are. Wish I had a pack of glow sticks for yah.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Oh yeah? You like being a disappointment?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh yeah? You like being a disappointment?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: All about the payment, huh? Not sure why I thought any different.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All about the payment, huh? Not sure why I thought any different.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: What about it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about it?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Hmm except there is. If the status quo happened to be so great we'd never advance! There would be no new tunes or vibes or places to go!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmm except there is. If the status quo happened to be so great we'd never advance! There would be no new tunes or vibes or places to go!

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Oh, well, good. So... now we test the waters. Tease a collab and climb back into Starlight Lounge. If you could help get us in there it would guarantee we rightfully reclaim our spot on the dance floor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, well, good. So... now we test the waters. Tease a collab and climb back into Starlight Lounge. If you could help get us in there it would guarantee we rightfully reclaim our spot on the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: That was cheesy but I appreciate the effort. I'll give yah a pass since you're cute. You like to dance at all?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That was cheesy but I appreciate the effort. I'll give yah a pass since you're cute. You like to dance at all?

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Well I got your Lims right here. Willing to pay double if you can do something else for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I got your Lims right here. Willing to pay double if you can do something else for me.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: These places like a flashy show. A bass drop they can market. Something that vibrates Lims into their tils. We show 'em the Club Rat Kids are back in a banger way and we'll be set.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: These places like a flashy show. A bass drop they can market. Something that vibrates Lims into their tils. We show 'em the Club Rat Kids are back in a banger way and we'll be set.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: We zaff something! I need you to talk to Zaffer, see if that graffiti genius can work something up. Something big.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We zaff something! I need you to talk to Zaffer, see if that graffiti genius can work something up. Something big.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: Nice!!! We're gettin' back to the big leagues! Spire here we come! Then, who knows? Onto Luna!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nice!!! We're gettin' back to the big leagues! Spire here we come! Then, who knows? Onto Luna!

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: We'll have to do that sometime. There's absolutely nothing like a sweaty grind sesh under neon lights and pulsing speakers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We'll have to do that sometime. There's absolutely nothing like a sweaty grind sesh under neon lights and pulsing speakers.

nodes.speaker: Kenzy Voan
nodes.text: You sure? This could be a chance for you to ride up to the top with us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sure? This could be a chance for you to ride up to the top with us.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We did.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I did it for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I did it for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: About that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: About that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Appreciate the confidence.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Appreciate the confidence.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm glad I could disappoint you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm glad I could disappoint you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm glad I could disappoint you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm glad I could disappoint you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll add your lack of confidence to my fee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll add your lack of confidence to my fee.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll add your lack of confidence to my fee.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll add your lack of confidence to my fee.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's nothing wrong with the status quo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's nothing wrong with the status quo.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There's nothing wrong with the status quo.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There's nothing wrong with the status quo.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not at all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not at all.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't mention it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't mention it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You glow enough for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You glow enough for me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So, about my fee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, about my fee.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If it gets under your skin, sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If it gets under your skin, sure.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If it gets under your skin, sure.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If it gets under your skin, sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We both know I'm not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We both know I'm not.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: My fee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My fee.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you're always searching then you're never truly happy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you're always searching then you're never truly happy.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you're always searching then you're never truly happy.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you're always searching then you're never truly happy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wouldn't that be fun to do with someone?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wouldn't that be fun to do with someone?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wouldn't that be fun to do with someone?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wouldn't that be fun to do with someone?

nodes.text: What else do we need to do?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: What else do we need to do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What else do we need to do?

nodes.text: I'll take you anywhere you want to go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll take you anywhere you want to go.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll take you anywhere you want to go.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll take you anywhere you want to go.

nodes.text: Neither do I.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Neither do I.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's all good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's all good.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Because you're celebrating. You're allowed to do that.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: Because you're celebrating. You're allowed to do that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Because you're celebrating. You're allowed to do that.

nodes.text: How do we do that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do we do that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You got it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'd love to dance with you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd love to dance with you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'd love to dance with you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'd love to dance with you.

nodes.text: Sometimes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Agreed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Agreed.

nodes.text: What's next?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's next?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I gotta get back to my own thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I gotta get back to my own thing.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I gotta get back to my own thing.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I gotta get back to my own thing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure!
